intro: Mahren Skyseer is a Horde journey that directs proven hunters from Camp Taurajo out toward the eastern shores of the Barrens. After mastering the plains' predators, adventurers are sent by Jorn Skyseer to learn coastal tracking from his sister. Finding her requires braving the waters and human encampments dotting the Merchant Coast.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You have hunted the beasts of the Barrens. Your spirit is strong. But a hunter must always be prepared. A true hunter can stalk prey down any path. Mountains and swamps will not sway them.
Find my sister, Mahren. She hunts the great water beasts along the coast. She will be your teacher in their ways.
But be wary in your search for her, for the Barrens' coast is held by humans.

clips.title: Completion
paras: My brother sent you, did he? Then you must have proven yourself to him. If you have earned the respect of Jorn, then you have my respect as well.
Are you ready to tread farther down the hunter's path?
